title: Japanese-Style Mushroom and Golden Potato Gratin
description: A rich and creamy gratin dish featuring sautéed mushrooms and golden potatoes, inspired by Japanese flavors.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the golden potatoes.
In a pan, heat sesame oil over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together soy sauce and dashi broth. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes. Top with a layer of mushroom mixture, then a layer of grated gratin.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Pour the soy dashi broth mixture over the potatoes, making sure they are fully submerged.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top of the gratin and serve hot.
